data: DMG 78084 does not turn a claimant who normally lives with another person into someone normally living alone during a temporary care-home stay. DMG 78085 retains household membership for a temporarily absent partner, but DMG 78086 requires a review of Pension Credit and the severe-disability addition if residential care exceeds 28 days and DLA payability ceases. The example continues on the next page. These are component and qualifying-benefit conditions, not a universal 28-day end to Pension Credit.
